name: visimark-mcp
description: A stdio MCP server exposing the VisiMark engine to agents: every command as a tool, the authoring discipline as resources, read-only unless an operator opens the write gate.
author: Michał Niedźwiedzki <michal@epsi.pl>

scripts.build: bun ../../scripts/gen-mcp-skill.ts && bun build src/main.ts src/index.ts --target node --outdir dist --external visimark --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
